svg.title: The whole run on one page
svg.desc: A map of a run in four acts. Act one, find: start, find the film, get subtitles. Act two, understand: audio hints run beside the bible writer and the second reader; when the audio is done the voice mapper and a second reader for voices run side by side; a script compares the answers and a judge settles any difference. Act three, translate: one translator per chunk at the same time, then a script checks every cue and broken cues go back for up to three fix rounds. Act four, finish: one reviewer reads the whole film, then the file is delivered next to the video. Blue is a script, green a local model, red is Claude.
svg.text: Checks the tools, reads your preferences
Your disk, then OpenSubtitles, then speech
Who speaks each line, and a sync check
Names, terms, who says sen or siz
Says which character each voice is
Answers the same voice questions blind
Only if they differ: settles it from the cited lines
A script checks every single cue
Only if needed: broken cues go back, up to 3 rounds
Reads the whole film next to the source
Saves the .tr.srt by the video, writes the report
A local model, on your machine
The numbers are the steps in ARCHITECTURE.md
